The '''altar of death''' was a room on the [[Charon/Legends|Charon]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Desolate]]''. It was on the fourth and final platform inside the ship, and it functioned as as temple for the [[Charon Death Cult]], dedicated to the [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] that destroyed their [[Charon homeworld|homeworld]]. A solid [[Color/Legends|black]] monolith stood in the center of the room. It carried an aura of [[Death/Legends|death]] and had negative effects on the emotions of any [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] beings who encountered it. 

When the crew of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|ship]] ''[[Long Shot]]'' [[Mutiny on the Celestial|arrived]] in [[Otherspace]] and began to explore the ''Desolate'', they ended up in the altar of death. After the monolith began to drain their life forces, the [[Cathorn]]&mdash;a construct [[Bioengineering/Legends|bio-engineered]] by Charon [[bioscientist]]s&mdash;leapt out and [[Skirmish on the Desolate|attacked]] them. They defeated it and continued on to the vessel's living [[Computer/Legends|computer]].
